[Back to the lesson](queries-keys-values.qmd) · [Learning path plan](review-path.qmd#computation)

## What to remember {#revision-essentials}

- A self-attention head projects each state into a query Q, key K and value V using learned matrices.
- For one position, the query is compared with keys from accessible positions. The score contributes to the weight assigned to each position.
- The output combines the values using those weights. Keys contribute to comparison, and values provide the content being aggregated.

## Recall from memory {#revision-check}

With Q, K and the mask fixed, what can changing V affect within one head?

<details>
<summary>Show the answer</summary>

Changing V can change the weighted sum. The weights depend on the scores computed from Q and K and the positions allowed by the mask.

</details>

::: {.visual-recall}

### Visual card — From scores to output {#visual-recall}

At one position, which projections feed the score calculation and which feed the weighted sum? Place Q, K, and V in slots A, B, and C.

```{=html}
<div class="visual-recall__diagram" role="img" aria-label="Step 1, A for the current position and B for the accessible positions give the scores and then the weights. Step 2, those weights and C for the accessible positions give the output.">
  <div class="visual-recall__lane">
    <span class="visual-recall__slot"><strong>A</strong> · current position</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__operator">×</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__slot"><strong>B</strong> · accessible positions</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__operator">→</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__node">Scores, then weights</span>
  </div>
  <div class="visual-recall__lane">
    <span class="visual-recall__node">Weights</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__operator">×</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__slot"><strong>C</strong> · accessible positions</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__operator">→</span>
    <span class="visual-recall__node">Weighted sum</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

<details>
<summary>Show the card answer</summary>

**A = Q** and **B = K**. The scaled dot product of the current query and each accessible key gives one score. Softmax gives the weights over the accessible positions. **C = V**. The output is the sum of the values weighted by those weights.

</details>

:::
